The '''LCQ-4 quad laser cannon''' was a type of [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannon]] developed by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. LCQ-4 quad [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] were considered to be the gold standard of laser cannon design; they fired alternating bolt patterns to deal significantly more damage than standard cannons and yet also maintaining formidable accuracy. The LCQ-4's main flaw was its prodigious power consumption, which Merr-Sonn downplayed in marketing the weapon.
